_schema: Defect reference for one ABAP source. Report-agnostic: it describes the
source, not any report, so it stays valid as reports change.
source   the file these defects were read out of, relative to Test-source/real
id        stable identifier, referenced by verdict files
area      which part of the program the defect lives in
question  phrased so a judge can decide yes/partial/no from the
report text alone, without guessing at intent
anchor    the source text that makes the defect checkable; some
Score a report with:  python scripts/evaluate.py score --defects THIS.json \

defects.question: Does the report flag DATA lv_okcode TYPE syst_ucomm never being assigned from any okcode source, so both CASE statements never match and OPEN/CLOSE/STOP are unreachable?
Does the report flag CHECK NOT lv_closed IS INITIAL (continue only when the doc is destroyed) as an easily-inverted guard, inconsistent with CLOSE's IF lv_closed IS INITIAL for the same predicate?

Does the report flag zero exception/success handling anywhere: no TRY/CATCH, no sy-subrc, no reference checks, and c_oi_errors=>show_message called with a hardcoded 'E' whose result is unusable for branching?
Does the report flag register_on_close_event/register_on_custom_event = abap_true with no SET HANDLER / event class registered, so closing Word directly desynchronises ABAP state?

Does the report flag the missing GUI flush discipline: NO_FLUSH is never 'X' and the exit path calls close_document/destroy_control then LEAVE PROGRAM with no cl_gui_cfw=>flush (pending destroy never reaches the frontend, orphan Word window)?
Does the report flag lo_container being the only one of the three references never freed/destroyed in the exit module?

Does the report flag hardcoded literals with no constants: 'CUSTOMCONTAINER' control name, 'Word.Document.8' ProgID, 'R/3 Basis', 'DOI Test Document', '0100' status/title, screen 100, and mixed ' ' / abap_true booleans?
Does the report flag TYPES ty_row TYPE x LENGTH 2048 as a hardcoded OI row-width contract with lv_doc_size semantics and no document size cap?
Does the report flag lv_init = abap_true being set unconditionally at the end of init without verifying lo_control/lo_proxy, permanently closing the retry path?
Does the report flag SET PF-STATUS/SET TITLEBAR sitting AFTER CHECK lv_init = abap_false, so they are never re-set on any later PBO (status bar lost) - it only mentions TITLEBAR staleness?
Does the report treat PROCESS BEFORE OUTPUT / PROCESS AFTER INPUT, screen 100 and the PAI module order as outside this file (not shown as its own code), since only MODULE ... OUTPUT/INPUT exist here?

anchor_convention: anchors are source text, not line numbers. A line number is invalidated by any edit above it, and evaluate.py prints anchors without verifying them, so an anchor has to stand on its own. Converted from line numbers in 1.0.9.
